definition: a small old hotel for travellers
description: An old stone inn with a snowy roof stands in a mountain village at dusk. A young woman with long red hair, in a cream winter coat, bobble hat and scarf, pulls a suitcase through deep snow towards the arched wooden door, where a man in a dark jacket waits in the warm light. A big brown and white St Bernard dog carries a lit lantern in its mouth and walks ahead of her up to the door. The man reaches up beside the door and smiles. Skis lean against the wall under a blank hanging wooden sign, and logs are stacked by the house.

de.answer: Sie zieht einen Koffer durch den Schnee.
